mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 900K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 900K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150K signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 6% and PAYEMS > 150K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 signals increased economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 105 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below $15.5T signals decreased economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 15500, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.5% and decrease in RSAFS below $400B signals monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and RSAFS < 400B, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7% signals a weak labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in stagnation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 240 signals increased inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
